recommendation_summary: The reply recommends one externally hosted heartbeat check that `nightly-sync` pings only after it finishes successfully, and that emails the user if no ping arrives by a morning deadline.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and moving everything into Docker.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own notification, so an early crash silences it.
labels.Checked myself: From your account, four startup failures prevented the summary email; no independent alert exists.

note: The reply recommends a single hosted dead-man alert, explicitly rejects the Synology/Docker stack, and grounds its checks in the user's own account.
